author: Cytokinesis
body:
We're looking for some good players, however all are welcome to apply! If interested, please respond in the following format:

IGN:
Real Name/Nickname:
Skype:
Best Positions(2):
Timezone:
Do You Believe in Yourself?:
How could you benefit the team?/Why should we pick you?:
BONUS QUESTION:
How Many Tacos?:

If we think you are a good candidate, one of the leaders will spectate you ingame, gamemode doesn't matter(however you may not be notified that we're watching)

Good luck to all who apply! :)

replies.author: Myv
replies.body:
I'm the official leader of Dexterity.

I do not have Skype, so if you wish to contact me then please talk to me in game privately ( do /msg _Za etc.)

All of our members are chosen mainly by me, we agree together to invite others and make sure that we have quality, not quantity.

If you wish to become a leader, message me, HoshikageRyuu or SkylarCalibrator and we will ask you why you wish to be a leader.

Thank you.
